text.content:
One line each. Every creature named here exists in the Icewind Dale Actors folders.

TownQuestGiverThe short versionWatch out for
BremenLake MonsterTaliSomething is taking fishers on Maer Dualdon.Plesiosaurus
BremenFoaming MugsSpeaker ShalescarRecover stolen mugs. Comedy, not combat.—
Bryn ShanderCold-Hearted KillerHlin TrollbaneTrack a serial killer working the caravan roads.Sephek Kaltro — Auril's chosen
Bryn ShanderMountain ClimbHruna, Korux, StornEscort three Battlehammer dwarves up Kelvin's Cairn.Yeti, Yeti Tyke
Bryn ShanderToil and TroubleSpeaker Duvessa ShaneGoblins raiding the road. Their boss is Izobai.Goblin Boss
Caer-DinevalGrand Dame Ice SailingSpeaker Crannoc SieverWin a race. Then notice the town is wrong.Kadroth, the Levistus cult
Caer-DinevalCult of the Frozen Rune(discovered)The speaker is a hostage in his own castle.Avarice, Gargle, Gurgle
Caer-KonigFish Out of WaterSpeaker TrovusSabotage at the docks — actually duergar.Nildar Sunblight
Caer-KonigMine ShaftAtenas SwiftA mine went quiet.Ogre Zombie, spore servants
Dougan's HoleNature SpiritsSpeaker Edgra DurmootKobolds and winter wolves have taken two children.Koran & Kanan, Norsu
Dougan's HoleSacrificial Lamb(town)The town intends to sacrifice someone to Auril.Moral, not mechanical
EasthavenCauldron of PlentySpeaker Danneth WaylenA sea hag is feeding the town. Badly.Maud Chiselbone
EasthavenToil and TroubleCaptain Imdra ArlaggathDuergar spotted near town.Durth Sunblight
Good MeadMead Mead Mead!Speaker RielsbarrowVerbeeg stole the mead stores.Duhg, Gahg, Yogobor
LonelywoodFoaming Mugs / Nature SpiritsSpeaker Nimsy HuddleA druid is killing hunters in revenge.Ravisin, Awakened White Moose
LonelywoodMountain Climb(tomb)An old tomb under the woods.Sahnar the mummy
TargosGutter RatsSpeaker Naerth MaxildanarrZhentarim errand. Naerth is not a nice man.Skath
TargosCold-Hearted Killer(the Luskan)A goliath werebear is loose in town.Oyaminartok
TermalaineMine ShaftSpeaker Oarus MasthewKobolds have taken the gem mine.Trex and his kobolds, Grell
TermalaineFoaming MugsMarta PeskrykMissing brewing supplies.—

Ten-Towns is a sandbox — these run in any order, and most can be resolved without a fight.
